sources.citation: Breton, Roland. 1995. Les Furu et leurs voisins: découverte et essai de classification d'un groupe de langues en voie d'extinction au Cameroun. Bilan géolinguistique des missions à Furu-Awa (1984-1986). Cahiers des Sciences Humaines 31(1): 17-48.
sources.note: Nothing. French expansion of the same survey. p. 18 writes the names tone-marked ('les trois langues furu - bùsùù, bishùo et bikyà'), the only tone-marked Busuu form in any opened source; a complete QEL wordlist for 'busu' was collected in 1984, and p. 48 (N.B.) records that all Furu-Awa QELs were thrown away when ISH Yaoundé was dissolved in 1991. No statement on tone system, stress or accent.

sources.citation: Breton, Roland. 1993. Is there a Furu language group? An investigation on the Cameroon-Nigeria border. Journal of West African Languages 23(2): 97-118.
sources.note: Nothing. Geolinguistic/lexicostatistic survey: Busuu had ten last speakers in 1985 (named in fn. 2, p. 104), 8%/7% lexical similarity with Nsaa/Nooni (pp. 104-105); 'only an advanced morphological analysis would be able to show..' (p. 105). No transcribed Busuu forms, no phonology, no mention of tone, stress or accent.
